text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Things have remained a bit awkward between 
Copano Rickey and Hokko Tarumae ever since 
the day of the Champions Cup.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: Um... Trainer-san.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry about before. I feel like I was 
a bit too harsh on Rickey back then.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: ...I'm sorry.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Harsh words spoken precisely because she 
acknowledged her ability. She seemed to 
regret having said them.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Is Ricky... is Ricky doing well and 
training hard?

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: Super... Which means...

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
She really seems to be dwelling on it. She 
tends to hide it the most when she's 
feeling down.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Hokko Tarumae's assessment was spot-on. 
Yes, Copano Rickey was—

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
"I'm gonna do it, totally gonna do it~♪ 
This time, I'll definitely blow Tarumae 
away!"

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Rickeyâ Luckyâ Full Throttle!!" 
craftsmanship

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The bigger the hole in someone's heart, 
the more cheerful they act on the surface 
to hide it. However...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Trainer, what was my time!?
choice_data_list:
...This isn't good. Your form is 
completely out of sync, too.

...This isn't looking good. Your form is 
completely spinning its wheels, too.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
You can fake an attitude, but you can't 
fake your running.
choice_data_list:
Ricky, just try not to overthink it, 
alright?

Ricky, just try not to worry too much, 
okay?

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Ehh... don't worry about it...? About 
what? I'm totally fine, but...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"...Because her awareness is lacking, my 
words won't reach her. If this keeps up—"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Performing well at the February Stakes and 
seizing the future was proving difficult. 
She had fallen into a truly invisible 
downward spiral.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, I just want to make everyone happy... 
Am I out of touch, I wonder...?

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
"Making every single person happy... Maybe 
that really is asking for the 
impossible...?"

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Nope, of course not! Feng shui power is 
invincible. Totally invincible☆

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Seeing her force a cheerful front was 
painful to watch. I have to find a way to 
get her back to normal...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Trainer. Looks like Rickey-chan is having 
a tough time.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Speaking of which, the one who arrived 
was... Smart Falcon.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
I wonder why. Everyone's such a good girl, 
just wishing for someone else's happiness.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
You know... I've been thinking... dirt 
track girls are all a bit clumsy in their 
own way, aren't they?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
I end up speaking my mind too bluntly, or 
fail to convey what I really want to say.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
"Still, that's what I love about them, 
though☆ Everyone is just so, so cute♪"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"...I agreed. It's precisely because 
they're clumsy and straightforward that 
they end up passing like ships in the 
night."
choice_data_list: What do you think I should do?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, I'm not really sure, but... I think 
everyone should just pursue what they're 
aiming for head-on.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Ricky-chan brings happiness with Feng 
Shui! Tarumae-chan puts her hometown on 
the map! And as for me—

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
As an umadol, cheering everyone up with 
song and dance♪ As long as I believe in 
myself and give it my all!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Believing in herself and giving it her 
all. Copano Rickey, who had always done 
just that, found herself unable to do so 
anymore.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"If there is a glimmer of hope to overcome 
this—"
choice_data_list: Smart Falcon, I have a favor to ask
Smart Falcon, I have a favor to ask

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: A favor? What is it?
choice_data_list: Could you cheer Ricky up for me?
Could you cheer Ricky up for me?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Cheering up Ricky-chan...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Every Umamusume possesses a special 
radiance entirely unique to herself.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even when a Trainer is helpless, perhaps 
an Umamusume—

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
“You're right. I'm the one who said you 
should just pursue what you're aiming for 
head-on. So there☆”

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
I'll try doing what I can♪ As 
Rickey-chan's slightly older senior, that 
is.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Watch me, Trainer-san☆

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And a few days later—

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, what are you doing in a place 
like this? Today's training is...
choice_data_list: Come on, just watch the stage.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Wait, the stage...?

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Wait, Falco-san?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Heeey, Rickey-chan☆ Good afternoon!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
"Today's super special! Just for you, 
Rickey-chan, I'm gonna hold a Falco 
Special Live all for yourself!"

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
You've seemed a bit lost lately, so here's 
a little cheer to brighten your day♪

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Take a look at this and regain the feng 
shui power you believe in, Rickey-chan♪

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: —Music, cue!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: This song is...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Let's do what we wanna do♪ Let's do what 
we can't even do♪

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
The power of feng shui is wonderful~♪ 
Everyone is waiting for it~♪

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
I'm sure she'll understand too! Once she 
runs with everything she's got, she'll get 
it! Fuu~!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It was a song I had never heard before. 
Likely an original written specifically 
for Copano Rickey. The song built up to an 
even higher crescendo—!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Do Rickey♪ Do Rickey♪ Go go Rickey♪

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Do Rickey♪ Do Rickey♪ Go go Rickey♪

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Do Rickey♪ Do Rickey♪ Go go Rickey♪ Fuu~!!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Waaah! Falco-san... Could this... be for 
me...?

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
What is this... Looking at it, my heart 
feels so tight... Why is it doing this...?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Every beat of the rhythm, every single 
smile, sends a surge of passion straight 
through Copano Rickey's heart.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
This is the power of an Umadol. The sheer 
power of Smart Falcon giving it her all.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Yay☆ How was that, Rickey-chan? Did it 
cheer you up a bit?

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Yeah, super-duper!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, yay! As an Umadol, I want to make 
everyone happy with this performance!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
B-But still... there are definitely other 
ways to make people happy besides singing. 
Not everyone loves singing, after all.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
"Times like this are when you need Feng 
Shui power☆ Maybe someone is waiting for 
the kind of encouragement that only 
Rickey-chan can give?"

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Encouragement... that only I can give...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Yep♪ Even if you get a little lost, keep 
on believing. Believe in what you hold 
dear.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
It's okay! You're not in the wrong, 
Rickey-chan. Because no matter what method 
you use—

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Because I truly wish for everyone's 
happiness from the bottom of my heart! And 
that's really wonderful, isn't it? ☆

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Falco-san...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As expected of Smart Falcon. A true 
idol—or rather, Umadol...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The lifeless spark in Copano Rickey's eyes 
swiftly returned. As if the sealed qi 
within her was overflowing once again.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
You're right. Feng shui isn't wrong. 
Because... Because it made me feel better!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
When I was little, learning about feng 
shui cheered me up. And when I taught feng 
shui to others, a lot of kids cheered up 
too!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
"As long as I don't give up, I know I can 
spread the circle of happiness infinitely! 
That's why...!"

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Mhm-mhm, exactly♪ Well then, we're all 
good to go now☆

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Yeah! Thank you, Falco-san! And also—

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
"It was probably you, Trainer, right? Who 
asked Falco-san for help."
choice_data_list:
Yeah. If it cheered you up even a little, 
I'm glad.

Yeah. I'm glad if that cheered you up a 
bit.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
"Way more than just a little!♪ I'm 
bursting with energy, I feel like I'm 
gonna pop!"

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
That really cleared my head! All I can do 
is stay true to myself and pour everything 
I care about into this!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
All right, from here on out, I'm gonna do 
my best again! Rickey☆ Lucky☆ Full-blown 
comeback--!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, thanks to the Umadol Smart 
Falcon's exceptional cheering song, Copano 
Rickey was brilliantly revitalized.
